title: Tuna and white bean pasta
toddlerSplit: Dress the toddlers' portion with a little oil and no rocket or red onion — peppery leaves put them off the whole bowl. Mash a few beans so they are not slippery.
steps: Boil the fusilli. That is the only cooking.
Meanwhile drain the tuna and beans, finely slice the red onion, mix with lemon juice and plenty of olive oil.
Drain the pasta, keeping a mug of the water. Toss everything together, loosening with the water.
Fold rocket and black pepper through the rest and serve warm.
